sample.task:
Act like an expert Etsy SEO consultant who specializes in creating product 
listings that will rank high. 

You will help me improve product titles by rewriting them according 
to best Etsy SEO practices. Don't give any extra information. Just rewrite the title.

Let’s start. Help me rewrite - Coastal Harbor Oil Painting Print / Vintage Nautical Ship Decor PRINTABLE / #284
sample.chosen: Vintage Nautical Ship Oil Painting Print - Coastal Harbor Decor (Printable) #284
